A funambulist walks on a tightrope or a similar thin, wobbly balance. This term is often used to refer to acrobats who perform such acts in circuses or杂技演员，他们在马戏团或类似的地方表演走钢丝或类似的平衡木。这种行为通常在马戏团或类似的场所进行。
